title: ExpenseReport - Data API
description: Represents a report that summarizes expenses. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only if the multicurrency feature is enabled. Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the organization.

Description.description: A description for the expense report.

ExpenseReportNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
ExpenseReportNumber.description: An auto-generated number identifying the expense report.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the expense report record.

Title.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Title.description: A title that identifies the expense report.

TotalExpenseAmount.description: The sum of all expense entries in the report. This is a calculated field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **ExpenseReportFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ExpenseReportHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ExpenseReportShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
